integrity.claim_scope: All primes \(p\), all integers \(a\ge1\), and all \(n\ge0\).
integrity.proof_basis: Exact formal-power-series argument over Z[[x]]; finite computation is supplementary only.

scientific_limitations: The theorem determines the exact common p-adic exponent, not every possible non-p primary factor common to all coefficient differences.
The explicit valuation formula is proved only for the sharp witness \(n=p^{a-1}\); other coefficient valuations are not classified.
title: Sharp one-step p-adic lift for prime-power hook/core congruences
